failure.what: The money-leg $0.60 run's PRIMARY artifacts did not survive box teardown. Verified locally:
failure.moneyleg_planted_cells_1_to_5: all directories exist but are EMPTY (no tokenizer.pt/predictor.pt)
failure.consequence: The cells whose mu-hat generate every verdict clause (the planted arm, and noise cells 4/5) are unrecoverable. Only the summary manifest (m6_moneyleg_rerun_manifest.json) survived. This is why the L1-L4 local work is scoped to noise cells 1,2,3 (re-score) and the acceptance planted cell4 (L3), the only trained checkpoints on disk.

standing_rule_landed.rule: NO box is destroyed until, for every cell: (i) the per-cell mu-hat SERIES (not just summary mean/std/frac_negative diagnostics), (ii) the tokenizer.pt + predictor.pt checkpoints, and (iii) the run manifest are pulled down to local disk AND hash-verified (sha256 recorded, re-read matches).
standing_rule_landed.scope: Standing for all cloud runs. For the real 15-day M6 run this is a HARD PRE-TEARDOWN GATE: teardown is blocked until the hash-verify passes, fail-closed.
standing_rule_landed.why_series_not_summary: The sign-lock pathology was only diagnosable because two cells shared a bit-identical IR; without the per-cell mu-hat and net series, we could not have re-derived activity or confirmed the filter never binds. Summary diagnostics (mean/std/frac_neg) were insufficient; the SERIES are the primary artifact.
